text: Hello and welcome to the live commentary of the Premier League clash between Bournemouth and Newcastle United at the Vitality Stadium.
Bournemouth enter the contest in the relegation zone in the Premier League.
The Cherries have suffered back-to-back defeats at the hands of Liverpool in the EFL Cup and Manchester City in the league, losing 6-1 last time out at the Etihad Stadium.
The pressure lifted on Andoni Iraola after their win over Burnley last month, but the spotlight is well and truly on the Spaniard again.
He needs another strong outing from his side against a Newcastle team in good form domestically.
Newcastle's Champions League hopes took a hit during the week after losing for the second time in a row to Borussia Dortmund.
Eddie Howe's men were depleted due to a number of injuries and suspensions, and the Magpies continue to deal with key absences today.
Despite limited options, Newcastle have maintained their excellent domestic form, extending their unbeaten run in league and cup to seven matches after a hard-fought win over Arsenal last time out.
They can close to within a point of the Champions League places with a win on the road.
Bournemouth have made five changes to their side from their 6-1 hammering at the hands of City.
Neto returns between the posts to replace Andrei Radu, while Senesi comes into the backline in place of Mepham.
Cook returns from suspension as Alex Scott misses out due to injury.
Philip Billing also misses out for the hosts.
Kluivert and Semenyo earn starts in the final third playing behind Solanke in attack.
Newcastle have made three changes to their side that was beaten 2-0 during the week by Dortmund.
Miley gets his first Premier League start by replacing Bruno Guimaraes, who misses out due to suspension.
Callum Wilson is missing due to a tight hamstring, so Gordon starts through the middle.
Almiron joins Gordon in the final third by replacing Livramento.
There will be a minute of silence before kick-off for Remembrance Day.
We're under way at the Vitality Stadium.
Kluivert feeds Tavernier's run in the inside-left channel and he forces a cutback towards Christie.
The midfielder shoots first time, but drills his attempt straight at Pope.
SAVE! Pope is called into action once again as Semenyo runs at the Newcastle defence and fires low and hard towards the bottom-right corner, but the Newcastle keeper gets down to make the stop.
Newcastle are looking to settle after allowing the Cherries a couple of attempts at goal in the early stages.
The Magpies will not want an end-to-end game after their exploits during the week.
Gordon has a probe down the left flank and wins a corner for the visitors that is cleared by the first Bournemouth defender.
SAVE! Longstaff latches onto a loose ball and he drills a strike towards the target.
It swerves in the air and forces Neto to turn it over the bar.
Tavernier has space on the break, but he takes a loose touch to allow Hall to make an important intervention.
BLOCK! Solanke finds space inside the Newcastle defence down the right flank.
He consider his options before launching an effort at goal that Lascelles deflects behind with a last-ditch block.
Kelly delivers a dangerous low cross into the middle, but no Bournemouth player reacts before Pope smothers it in the area.
Schar goes down clutching his hamstring as Pope gathers the ball.
He does not look comfortable and requires treatment.
Schar continues after receiving treatment, but his condition will be monitored by Howe and his staff.
Schar is involved in the action as he breaks up a pass towards Solanke on the edge of the box.
That will ease any concerns about his hamstring.
Semenyo needs treatment for a knock for the hosts.
Both teams are having issues with players tonight.
Newcastle will have been pleased to ride out the early wave of pressure.
The Magpies look more assured at the back now as Solanke and the runners from deep have been contained.
Bournemouth have been knocked out of their early rhythm.
The hosts do look a tad short of confidence following their defeat to City last week.
Miley has made a composed start for the Magpies in his first Premier League start.
The 17-year-old is a highly-touted prospect on Tyneside.
Almiron has a run at Kelly down the right flank and he wins a corner for the Magpies for his efforts.
SAVE! Willock hangs a cross to the back post for Lascelles to attack.
He powers a header towards goal that takes a deflection, but Neto makes a fine stop.
Lascelles may have been offside anyway, although it looked tight.
CHANCE! Kluivert breaks away from Willock in the middle of the park and bears down on the edge of the penalty area.
He shoots towards the left side of Pope's goal, but the Newcastle keeper beats it behind.
Dear me, Almiron is down for Newcastle now.
He appeared to injure himself on his run to win the corner a few minutes ago.
He gets looked at by the physio, but his game looks to be done.
Almiron is withdrawn with a potential hamstring injury and is replaced by former Bournemouth man Ritchie.
SAVE! Christie latches onto a loose ball in the box and drills an effort into the ground.
Pope sees the ball late, but he punches it away from danger with a fine stop.
Newcastle can't get themselves in the game at the moment.
The injury to Almiron is yet another setback for Howe and his limited options.
CHANCE! Solanke latches onto a long ball and offloads into the path of Semenyo.
He pokes the ball towards goal on his right foot, but he places his effort inches past the left post.
Gordon skips past Senesi with ease down the left flank and he drills a low ball into the middle that Tavernier has to clear away.
Semenyo spurns another opening in front of goal as he fails to take a touch from Christie's ball over the top.
He was in behind Hall and would have been one-on-one with Pope.
Trippier surges down the right and slides to try to send a cutback into the middle.
It ricochets off Kelly and onto the Newcastle skipper before heading out for a goal-kick.
Replays show that it struck the Bournemouth man last.
Solanke slips and remains down in a heap for the hosts.
Yet another stoppage in the game for a player to receive treatment.
There will be six minutes of added time.
Solanke is back out and appears to have shaken off his knock for now.
There has been a lack of cutting edge from the hosts as we approach the break.
Newcastle will be the happier of the two sides approaching half-time.
The tempo of the game has slowed significantly.
Both teams appear to be playing for half-time.
HALF-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 0-0 NEWCASTLE
It's goalless at the break in the Premier League clash between Bournemouth and Newcastle at the Vitality Stadium.
The Cherries have had the best of the opportunities as Ryan Christie saw two efforts saved by Nick Pope, while Antoine Semenyo and Justin Kluivert were also denied by the Newcastle keeper.
At the other end, Sean Longstaff and Jamaal Lascelles had the visitors' best attempts that were stopped by Neto.
The Cherries have looked short of confidence in front of goal.
With the Magpies missing a number of key players and losing another with Miguel Almiron being forced off, Iraola's team have a huge opportunity to secure an important win.
Hall is withdrawn at the break by Howe and is replaced by Livramento.
We're back under way at the Vitality Stadium.
CHANCE! Solanke intercepts a misplaced pass from Trippier and looks to Pope, but he takes a heavy touch and loses it behind for a goal-kick.
Bournemout continue to get opportunities in the final third, but have lacked a clinical edge when they've needed it the most.
Trippier loses possession and it allows Christie to feed Aarons down the right flank.
He fires into the box low and hard, but sees his delivery repelled by Schar.
Tavernier surges into the Newcastle box down the left flank and he cuts a pass back for Semenyo.
He shoots towards goal, only to see his effort blocked.
There's no penetration in the Bournemouth attack at the moment.
Newcastle are keeping them at bay with a solid defence through the middle.
Cook goes into the book for kicking the ball away after giving Gordon a nudge to the deck.
CHANCE! Trippier angles a perfect cross in from the left flank that hits Neto and the home side are able to scramble the loose ball away before Willock can capitalise.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! SOLANKE FIRES THE HOSTS AHEAD!!!!! 1-0!!!! The Cherries take the lead as Solanke buries his effort into the bottom-right corner.
Semenyo tries to force a pass through to Solanke and the forward benefits from a deflection.
He takes the ball in stride and fires low and hard into the net with a precise strike on his right foot.

text: Livramento runs down the left flank and has support from Gordon through the middle.
He lines up a blast from 20 yards, but he sends his effort straight at Neto.
Aarons is down for the hosts after running with Livramento.
He requires treatment before the game can continue.
Parkinson makes his Premier League bow for the Magpies as he replaces Miley.
Parkinson goes up front as Joelinton drops back.
Smith replaces Aarons at right-back as the latter is unable to continue after picking up a knock.
Kluivert was active in the first half, but faded a tad in the second.
Sinisterra replaces the Dutchman.
The problems mount for Howe and his staff as Longstaff goes down for the visitors.
The midfielder looks in pain.
Longstaff gets back to his feet and appears to ready to resume, but Howe has another injury concern.
SAVE! Tavernier latches onto an offload from Solanke and fires at goal on his left foot.
He powers a strike towards the top-left corner that Pope pushes behind.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!! SOLANKE NOTCHES HIS SECOND!!!! 2-0 BOURNEMOUTH!!!!! The Cherries extend their lead as Solanke bundles the ball home from close range.
Cook sends a dangerous cross into the box from the left flank that Sinisterra heads against the post.
Solanke is the first to react and steers his effort past Pope into the roof of the net.
There is a nervy wait for a VAR check for handball, but the goal stands.
Solanke has as many goals in the Premier League this season in 12 appearances (six) as he registered in 33 appearances last season.
OVER! Schar charges forward from the back and reaches the edge of the penalty area before he gets stopped.
The ball deflects to Longstaff in space, only to lift his effort over the top.
CLOSE! Sinisterra looks to wrap up the game for the hosts with a blast from distance, but his effort creeps inches wide of the post.
Ouattara replaces Semenyo, who had a bright start to the game, albeit lacking a cutting edge.
BLOCK! Solanke bursts down the right flank and sends a cutback to Sinisterra.
He takes a good first touch to roll Lascelles, but the Newcastle defender recovers to deflect his effort wide.
Willock takes a fine touch to beat two Bournemouth defenders, but Christie gets back to block his cross out for a corner.
Lascelles lunges in from behind on Ouattara and is shown a yellow card.
Senesi is booked for the hosts for dissent towards the referee following an appeal for a penalty.
There is a VAR check for handball against Gordon, but the decision stands as no penalty.
WIDE! Solanke looks for his hat-trick as he collects Christie's pass, but he slams his effort from the angle into the side-netting.
There will be seven minutes of added time.
SAVE! Quattara bursts down the left flank and tees up Sinisterra to strike.
He fires low and hard towards goal, but Pope makes the save and smothers the ball before Solanke can react.
Quattara wins the ball back and goes for goal from 20 yards, ignoring Solanke in support.
However, he smashes his strike straight at Pope.
WIDE! Tavernier latches onto a cutback from Quattara from the left and has an open goal to aim at, only to place his attempt wide of the target.
Schar lines up an ambitious effort from distance, only to launch his attempt well over the bar.
Willock endured a tough evening and is replaced by Krafth for the closing stages.
Tavernier impressed in the final third for the Cherries and perhaps should have scored.
He makes way for Rothwell.
WHAT A SAVE! Pope produces a brilliant reaction stop to turn Sinisterra's deflected strike over the top.
The winger connects with Christie's cross and it takes a wicked deflection off Lascelles.
Pope still manages to react to turn it over the bar.
The keeper has kept the scoreline respectable today.
FULL-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 2-0 NEWCASTLE
A brace from Dominic Solanke has guided Bournemouth to a 2-0 victory over Newcastle United in the Premier League.
The hosts spurned a number of opportunities in the first half, but Solanke broke the deadlock on the hour mark with a close-range finish.
He was on the spot again to bundle home the second from a corner to secure the three points.
The Cherries move out of the relegation zone after picking up their second win on the bounce at home, while Newcastle's seven-match unbeaten run in the top flight has come to an end.
Both teams will return to action after the international break as Bournemouth travel to Sheffield United, while Newcastle host Chelsea.
Thanks for joining our commentary, until next time, goodbye.
